Sandbox_JOST_Enabled_tooltip: Master toggle. When off, no starting-level grants or cap enforcement happen at all.
Sandbox_JOST_SynergyEnabled_tooltip: When on, a related skill with at least 1 pip grants this skill's cap a flat +1 (see the mod's linked-skill graph). When off, only a skill's own pips affect its cap.
Sandbox_JOST_AdminCapExempt_tooltip: When on, any player with Admin access level is automatically exempt from all skill caps -- no manual command needed. Starting levels are unaffected either way.
Sandbox_JOST_TrainingTraitsEnabled_toolt: When on (default), the four training traits (Experienced, Self Taught, Unfinished Education, Blank Slate) work as described. When off, picking any of them has NO effect -- every character just gets the 'Starting Level: Default (No Trait)' numbers below, regardless of trait picked. Traits remain selectable either way; this only turns off what they do.
Sandbox_JOST_StartLevel0Pips_tooltip: ONLY applies to a character who picked the Experienced trait. Starting level granted for a trade skill with no relevant trait/profession investment. <LINE> Recommended: 0
Sandbox_JOST_StartLevel1Pip_tooltip: ONLY applies to a character who picked the Experienced trait. Starting level granted for a trade skill with 1 pip of trait/profession investment. <LINE> Recommended: 3 -- if you want this to be a meaningful bonus, keep it HIGHER than 'Starting Level: Default (No Trait): 1 Pip' below, or picking Experienced costs 2 trait points for nothing.
Sandbox_JOST_StartLevel2Pips_tooltip: ONLY applies to a character who picked the Experienced trait. Starting level granted for a trade skill with 2 pips of trait/profession investment. <LINE> Recommended: 5 -- keep higher than the matching Default (No Trait) value below.
Sandbox_JOST_StartLevel3Pips_tooltip: ONLY applies to a character who picked the Experienced trait. Starting level granted for a trade skill with 3 pips of trait/profession investment. <LINE> Recommended: 7 -- keep higher than the matching Default (No Trait) value below.
Sandbox_JOST_StartLevel4PlusPips_tooltip: ONLY applies to a character who picked the Experienced trait. Starting level granted for a trade skill with 4 or more pips of trait/profession investment. <LINE> Recommended: 9 -- keep higher than the matching Default (No Trait) value below.
Sandbox_JOST_StartLevelDefault0Pips_tool: Applies to every character who did NOT pick a training trait (the vast majority of players). Starting level granted for a trade skill with no relevant trait/profession investment. <LINE> Recommended: 0
Sandbox_JOST_StartLevelDefault1Pip_toolt: Applies to every character who did NOT pick a training trait (the vast majority of players). Starting level granted for a trade skill with 1 pip of trait/profession investment. <LINE> Recommended: 2 -- keep lower than 'Starting Level (Experienced trait): 1 Pip' above.
Sandbox_JOST_StartLevelDefault2Pips_tool: Applies to every character who did NOT pick a training trait (the vast majority of players). Starting level granted for a trade skill with 2 pips of trait/profession investment. <LINE> Recommended: 4 -- keep lower than the matching Experienced-trait value above.
Sandbox_JOST_StartLevelDefault3Pips_tool: Applies to every character who did NOT pick a training trait (the vast majority of players). Starting level granted for a trade skill with 3 pips of trait/profession investment. <LINE> Recommended: 6 -- keep lower than the matching Experienced-trait value above.
Sandbox_JOST_StartLevelDefault4PlusPips_: Applies to every character who did NOT pick a training trait (the vast majority of players). Starting level granted for a trade skill with 4 or more pips of trait/profession investment. <LINE> Recommended: 7 -- keep lower than the matching Experienced-trait value above.
Sandbox_JOST_BaseCap0Pips_tooltip: Maximum level a trade skill with no relevant trait/profession investment can reach, before any linked-skill bonus. <LINE> Recommended: 4
Sandbox_JOST_BaseCap1Pip_tooltip: Maximum level a trade skill with 1 pip of investment can reach, before any linked-skill bonus. <LINE> Recommended: 5
Sandbox_JOST_BaseCap2Pips_tooltip: Maximum level a trade skill with 2 pips of investment can reach, before any linked-skill bonus. <LINE> Recommended: 7
Sandbox_JOST_BaseCap3Pips_tooltip: Maximum level a trade skill with 3 pips of investment can reach, before any linked-skill bonus. <LINE> Recommended: 9
Sandbox_JOST_BaseCap4PlusPips_tooltip: Maximum level a trade skill with 4 or more pips of investment can reach. <LINE> Recommended: 10 (effectively uncapped)
